entities.name: Emmanuel-François-Joseph de Bavière
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emmanuel François Joseph von Wittelsbach, Count of Bavaria, also called Chevalier of Bavaria, Marquess of Villacerf, was a high-ranking officer and politician under King Louis XV of France. He served, among other positions, as Governor of Péronne in Picardy.
